task.description:
WF-03 Step 1 — Root-cause diagnosis for GH-821 / ISS-0718.

Read the test file tests/integration/par02_partition_catalog_test.zig and locate line 177. Identify exactly:
1. What UUID literal is hardcoded there
2. What the UUID is used for (which test, which fixture)
3. Why this violates T010 isolation rules
4. What the correct fix is (replace with per-test-generated UUID via std.crypto.random or similar Zig mechanism)
5. Whether any other lines in the same file also use hardcoded UUIDs that should also be fixed

Document the diagnosis clearly so CODE-DESIGNER can produce an accurate fix design.
acceptance_criteria: The exact offending UUID literal is identified and quoted
The scope of the fix is defined (line 177 only, or more lines)
The correct Zig approach for per-test UUID generation is identified

result.summary:
DIAGNOSIS COMPLETE — ISS-0718 already resolved in commit bc9af23f; ISS-0718.json requires bookkeeping update to RESOLVED.

Category: A (logic/fixture error) — already fixed within the originating run (ADHOC-par02-03-05-release-20260817).

Root cause (historical, now fixed):
During ADHOC-par02-03-05-release-20260817, the new test 'par02_ac5: ensurePartitionAttached emits EXECUTION_PARTITION_CREATED' was drafted with a hardcoded non-sentinel UUID literal `"00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000ff"` passed to `bpm.api_tenant_context.set(...)`. This UUID is NOT the all-zeros sentinel (ends in `0000000000ff`, not `000000000000`), so T010 flagged it. ISS-0718 was registered and GH-821 filed during that run's step-0.5.

Fix applied (bc9af23f, 2026-08-18T01:10:39Z):
The UUID was changed to `"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"` (the all-zeros sentinel), which lint_test_isolation.py explicitly exempts via `ALL_ZEROS_UUID` constant. This is semantically correct: `bpm.api_tenant_context.set` for platform-level operations uses the all-zeros no-tenant sentinel, not a per-test random UUID. The fix is in `tests/integration/par02_partition_catalog_test.zig` line 235.

Current state verified:
- `python tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration/par02_partition_catalog_test.zig` → `OK — 1 file(s) checked, no isolation issues.`
- Only UUID literal in the file is `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000` at line 235 (exempted sentinel).
- No other hardcoded non-sentinel UUIDs exist anywhere in the file.
- `randomSuffix()` helper (line 17) and all three test cases use `h.newUuidString()` for per-test fixture names — fully T010-compliant.

Scope: Line 235 only was the offending site. No further lines in the file violate T010.

Required follow-up (Step 2 action):
Update ISS-0718.json status to RESOLVED with resolution note referencing bc9af23f. Close GH-821. No source code changes required — fix is already in HEAD.
